title: Automatic Sweep: Optimizing Cash Flow with Smart Sweeps
summary: Explains how to optimize Automatic Sweep cash flow by choosing a receiving savings account that is Bronze-only, setting sweep notification alerts for sweeps ≥ $1,000, and adjusting sweep thresholds. Also recommends revisiting sweep settings seasonally for changing receivables and payables.
